caption:
More trades do not automatically mean more progress.

Repeated entries can come from boredom, frustration, or trying to recover a loss. A written plan can define when a setup is valid and when to stop for the day. Track whether each trade followed your rules rather than judging yourself only by the result. Sometimes the disciplined decision is to do nothing.

Educational content only; not financial advice.
